What the export includes is decided in the service.

terms.meaning: a setting that tells browsers and caches not to keep a copy of a response

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Download my data handler
sections.what: Returns the signed-in user's data as a downloadable JSON file that browsers and caches are told not to keep.
sections.why: Likely reason: personal data should not stay in a browser cache.
sections.watch_out: The file contains whatever the export function returns, so the export function decides what personal data leaves the app.

summary: Lets a signed-in user download all of their data as a JSON file.
purpose: Meets the need for users to take a copy of their own data.
why: Likely reason: a data download is a privacy right, and the no-store setting keeps the copy out of browser caches.
how: 1) Confirms sign-in. 2) Gathers the user's data through the export function. 3) Returns it as a JSON file with a download name and no-store cache setting.
inputs: A GET with the session. The data comes from the account service.
risks: Anything the export function returns is included, so new personal fields added there are exported automatically.
debug: If the export is incomplete, check the export function in the account service.
